C1661.title: Unauthorized Access Vulnerabilities in Credit Card APIs of 20 Banks
C1661.summary: A security review of domestic banking APIs found security flaws across 38 banks, with 20 banks exhibiting high-risk unauthorized access vulnerabilities in their credit card APIs. Attackers could exploit these interfaces to bypass authorization checks and access sensitive cardholder information or perform unauthorized operations.

references.title: Financial Industry at a Regulatory Crossroads: API Security in Focus
